value.rationale: The finding resolves a natural transport-direction question for the source fixed-potential local-reset ratchet. It proves reset-rate-only reversal using two distinct, explicitly certified mechanisms: rare-reset global equilibrium scale imbalance and frequent-reset local barrier distance. The construction extends robustly to smooth single-well substrates, providing a nontrivial mechanism and counterexample to universal geometry-selected direction.
